rules.requires: One uniquely identified anisotropic non-H atom; no local disorder/short-contact/type-assignment flags
Explicit bonded anisotropic pair in same PART/RESI; no local chemical ambiguity
One C/N/O site; supplied SFAC alternatives; no riding-H changes
Existing simple full-occupancy C-O-H and one unambiguous carbon anchor
Last shift/esd explicitly identifies an existing H in an eligible riding group
Use one verified list of 1..20 active outliers; compare all-data and OMIT working refinements and carry forward the checked selection with explicit reporting.

mainline.title: 初解及初筛
mainline.action: SHELXT + initial-review；必要时按证据走 SHELXD 分支

mainline.title: 化学合理性与加氢
mainline.action: 先核对元素、键连/价态、电荷、H、组成及占有率；参考模型需本次数据核验

mainline.title: 精修和权重
mainline.action: SHELXL；记录几何、占有率、ADP、差值密度

mainline.title: 结构问题与A/B处理
mainline.action: 化学与衍射证据优先；ab-auto试修并保留对照；合理模型可保留已说明的AB

mainline.title: 官网及双语Word
mainline.action: 复核后的同一最终CIF；已授权IUCr PDF + 中英文Word

mainline.title: 客户交付
mainline.action: 原始目录/Cairystal；四个明确文件链接，剩余问题如实说明

reflection_selection_scope: Set allow_automatic_reflection_omission=false for comparison only, or automatic_reflection_trials=false to retain all reflections. A previous point OMIT prevents another automatic selection.
reference_model_policy: Use supplied/authorized references with current-data verification and explicit provenance; explicit blind/no-reference instructions still govern that run.
